research_scope: Corrections and reconciliations identified after independent current-version review of the core Awoken roster.

corrections.name: Ultra Instinct
corrections.notes: The current consolidated Awoken table lists 500 Ki activation and 100 Stamina per automatic dodge. Older references describing different activation behavior are retained as historical/version-sensitive information rather than silently overwriting the current record.

corrections.name: Power Pole Pro
corrections.notes: The dedicated skill reference explicitly identifies Power Pole Pro as requiring zero Ki. It grants the Nimbus/Power Pole moveset and ends when the user takes hitstun or is grabbed.

corrections.name: The Power to Overcome
corrections.notes: Independent 2026 sources agree that this is a two-stage CaC Awoken skill. The second stage has distinct resource behavior, but exact duration/timing and the full resource transition remain inconsistently documented. The wiki therefore leaves those numeric details unresolved instead of converting community testing into a canonical value.

corrections.name: Power Pole Pro

current_record.requirement: Level 35 and completion of the Great Saiyaman questline at Hercule House

corrections.notes: The dedicated reference gives a Level 35 gate and the multi-step Great Saiyaman quest chain, ending in the fourth mission that awards the Awoken Skill.
